fairUse.provenance: Grail Games’ official sold-out original-stock listing https://www.grailgames.games/store/p/the-manhattan-project-energy-empire displays this boxed game with the Minion Games publisher logo. Grail Games’ 2024 announcement https://www.grailgames.games/davids-blog/n5jnpjqp63iammjou2osstk3unrd79 explicitly distinguishes its upcoming re-release with all-new art from the original edition. The original Minion Games 2016 English rulebook at https://static1.squarespace.com/static/62e17bf47de1842f5a971df9/t/659376b6e7dc57094bc8048f/1704163048302/EnergyEmpireRules.pdf credits Jeffrey Edwards for box illustrations and confirms the game and 2016 edition. The image is hosted in Grail Games’ own media library. Reduced to 258 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The person who used the least fuel to get from home to where the game is being played starts.
clarifications: Starting money is assigned by turn order.

sources.title: The Manhattan Project: Energy Empire: English rulebook
